  }
  function drawArm(a,p,angle,mirror){
    const [sx,sy,ex,ey,wx,wy,r,e,w,,handWidth,handLength,spread,front]=p;
    limbSegment(a.upper,a.upperShape,sx,sy,ex,ey,r,e,false);
    const L=limbSegment(a.fore,a.foreShape,ex,ey,wx,wy,e,w,true);
    const start=L*.64;
    const q=e*.37+w*.63;
    attr(a.wrist,'d',`M${-q} ${start} Q${-w*1.14} ${L*.91} ${-w} ${L} Q0 ${L+w*1.35} ${w} ${L} Q${w*1.14} ${L*.91} ${q} ${start}Z`);
    attr(a.hand,'transform',`translate(${wx} ${wy}) rotate(${angle}) scale(${mirror*handWidth} ${handLength})`);
    const open=Math.max(0,spread), curl=Math.max(0,-spread);
    const wide=1+.3*open;
    let d=`M-4.5 -2 Q-6.8 .5 -7.2 5.4`;
    const thumbX=-8.7-11*open, thumbY=16.5-17*open-6*curl;
    d+=`Q-9.3 8.1 ${thumbX} ${thumbY} Q${thumbX-.7} ${thumbY+3.4} ${thumbX+2.1} ${thumbY+2.3} Q-6.5 13 -5.1 12.3`;
    const roots=[-5.2,-2,.98,4.05,6.95];
    const tips=[-6.6,-2.3,2.1,6.6];
    const lengths=[25.5,30,28.3,23.8];
    for(let f=0;f<4;f++){
      const tx=tips[f]*(1+open*1.35)*(1-curl*.42);
      const ty=lengths[f]-curl*(f===0?22:25)-open*(f===3?1:0);
      const end=roots[f+1]*wide;
      d+=`Q${tx-1.8} ${ty-5} ${tx-1.5} ${ty-.8} Q${tx-.4} ${ty+2.4} ${tx+1.2} ${ty} Q${tx+2.2} ${ty-1.4} ${end} ${f===3?10:15.8-curl*6}`;
    }
    d+=`Q8 3.6 4.8 -1.8 Q0 -4 -4.5 -2Z`;
    attr(a.silhouette,'d',d);
    attr(a.glint,'d','M-4.3 1.3 Q-5.8 5 -5.6 8.2');
    attr(a.front,'opacity',front);
  }

  function poseAt(t){
    const ms=((t%5540)+5540)%5540;
    let k=0;
    while(k<times.length-1 && ms>=times[k+1]) k++;
    const next=Math.min(k+1,times.length-1);
    const f=next===k?0:(ms-times[k])/(times[next]-times[k]);
    const z=f*f*(3-2*f);
    const get=seq=>seq[k].map((v,i)=>v+(seq[next][i]-v)*z);
    const angle=seq=>{
      const a=seq[k][9], b=seq[next][9];
      return a+(((b-a+540)%360)-180)*z;
    };
    return {get,angle};
  }
  function drawEye(side,x,y,size,open,profile){
    const eye=$('eye-'+side);
    attr(eye,'transform',`translate(${x} ${y}) scale(${size*(1-.43*profile)} ${size})`);
    const pupil=$('eye-'+side+'-open');
    attr(pupil,'opacity',Math.min(1,open*1.23));
    attr(pupil,'transform',`scale(1 ${.09+.91*open})`);
  }
  function render(t){
    const {get,angle}=poseAt(t);
    attr($('body-outline'),'d',contourPath(get(contours)));
    const [lx,ly,lsx,lsy]=get(legPoses);
    attr($('legs'),'transform',`translate(${lx} ${ly}) scale(${lsx} ${lsy})`);
    const [bx,by,bw,bh,offset,compression,orange]=get(bellies);
    attr($('rounded-belly'),'transform',`translate(${bx} ${by}) scale(${bw} ${bh})`);
    attr($('belly-front-light'),'transform',`translate(${offset} 0) scale(${compression} 1)`);
    const profile=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,-offset/48));
    attr($('shoulder-light'),'transform',`translate(${offset*.35} 0)`);
    attr($('flank-light'),'opacity',.78-profile*.51);
    attr($('flank-gold'),'opacity',orange);
    const [hx,hy,hw,hh,ax,ay,as,bex,bey,bs,open]=get(faces);
    attr($('head-modeling'),'transform',`translate(${hx} ${hy}) scale(${hw} ${hh})`);
    drawEye('left',ax,ay,as,open,profile);
    drawEye('right',bex,bey,bs,open,0);
    const [x,y,x2,y2,bend,thick]=get(smiles);
    const mid=(x+x2)/2, yc=(y+y2)/2+bend;
    attr($('muzzle-light'),'transform',`translate(${mid} ${(y+y2)/2-3.3}) scale(${(x2-x)/23} ${hh})`);
    attr($('lip-line'),'d',`M${x} ${y} Q${mid} ${yc} ${x2} ${y2} Q${mid+1} ${yc+thick*2} ${x} ${y+.45}Z`);
    attr($('lip-light'),'d',`M${x+1} ${y+2.1} Q${mid} ${yc+thick*2.4} ${x2-1} ${y2+1.65}`);
    attr($('lip-light'),'stroke-width',1.05*hh);
    drawArm(farArm,get(rightArms),angle(rightArms),-1);
    drawArm(nearArm,get(leftArms),angle(leftArms),1);
  }
  window.nwb={render};
  render(0);
})();
</script>
</svg>
</body>
